definition: Months from treatment start to progression or last follow-up
interpretation_boundary: Published survival endpoint reconciled to the published risk table and swimmer plot

definition: Count of deduplicated protein-altering records in the official Lee MAF
interpretation_boundary: Not clinical TMB because no callable-megabase denominator is provided in the official supplement

definition: Equality of the two published HLA-A alleles
interpretation_boundary: The low-mutation/HLA-A-homozygous cell is empty; no independent HLA-A or interaction estimate is identifiable

definition: Count of linked protein-altering mutation records per patient
coding_or_scale: Rank variable and raw count scaled by empirical IQR (75th minus 25th percentile)

definition: Base-2 log of numeric mg/kg parsed from TREATMENT_GROUP
interpretation_boundary: Adjustment covariate only; dose labels are source-data derived

missingness_in_fitted_model: None among the fitted conditional model subset

coding_or_scale: Continuous with median and upper-tertile sensitivity strata
interpretation_boundary: Targeted-panel TMB; not interchangeable with Lee protein-altering mutation count

definition: At least one HLA-A/HLA-B/HLA-C locus homozygous from linked MSK50K HLA fields
interpretation_boundary: Post hoc conditional association; not an HLA-A-specific direct replication
